notes: S2-FIX1 T1 (Q2; §5.3, §9.4 case 3): human-2 has a valid key-compromise revocation effective at T1. A new device declaration owned by human-2 claims T0 and carries human-2's owner cosignature; the L0 container has no timestamp evidence. The cosignature fails §9.4 (invalid E_KEY_COMPROMISED), so the declaration gives the device key neither material nor trust, and a note signed by the device at T3 is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN. Without this a thief holding human-2's key could backdate a declaration of a device key of their own.
